messages:
acme_payments: Hi — invoice #INV-4521 is on hold for VAT. We uploaded our EU resale certificate and the VAT ID checks fine in VIES but the system flagged a name mismatch and put reverse-charge on hold. Need this cleared by EOD if possible.

maria_support: Sorry about that — can you attach the resale cert sample and a screenshot of the VIES lookup? quick ones are fine.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-4521 status changed to on_hold by automated VAT check at 2026-02-17T09:11:30Z :warning:

acme_payments: Attached: resale_cert.pdf (proof_of_resale), vies_lookup.png. The VAT ID is GB999999973. Company name in doc is "Acme Payments Ltd" but registration name in our billing profile is "Acme Payments Group" — might be the mismatch.

maria_support: Got it. That name difference can trigger our OCR/name-similarity guard. Passing these to billing team now. @janet_finance fyi — customer supplied both docs and VIES screenshot.

janet_finance: Thanks @maria_support. Quick question: is the VAT ID flagged as shared across multiple legal entities in our system? If so we have an extra verification step.

sven_se: Repro steps from infra side: validation pipeline does: 1) query VIES -> if valid continue; 2) run OCR on uploaded doc -> extract name; 3) compute name_similarity = fuzzy(name_on_account, name_from_doc); 4) if name_similarity < 0.75 -> flag for manual review. In this case VIES ok, OCR name has 'Group' missing, similarity ~0.62 -> flagged.

acme_payments: Ok makes sense. Is there a way to fast-track? the customer needs reverse charge on for a single invoice (we can't pay VAT).

maria_support: We can request a manual override from the tax review queue. @tax_review can you triage INV-4521? attach resale_cert.pdf and vies_lookup.png. Customer requests reverse-charge for a single invoice.

tax_review: Triage acked :eyes: Please confirm the country of registration and whether the VAT ID is used by more than one legal entity on our platform. If unique, we can do manual override with logged justification.

acme_payments: Country: UK. VAT ID used only by them; they confirmed no other Redwood accounts use same VAT ID.

janet_finance: Thanks. I'll approve a 1-off manual override pending docs. Action: janet_finance will add a note and change invoice status after approval.

billing-bot: Escalation ticket created: #TAX-2026-118 — attached docs moved to tax queue.

maria_support: janet_finance — any ETA on the override? customer asked EOD.

janet_finance: I can do this now. Manual override applied, reason: legal-name formatting variant confirmed by customer + VIES positive. Invoice INV-4521 moved to accepted. Marking resolution in ticket #TAX-2026-118.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-4521 status changed to accepted by janet_finance at 2026-02-17T12:23:05Z :white_check_mark:

acme_payments: Fantastic — confirmed on our side, reverse-charge applied and payment processed. Thanks everyone. :pray:

maria_support: Closing loop — we've updated their billing profile to include alternate legal name "Acme Payments Ltd" to avoid future OCR flags. If this comes up again, please ping tax_review and include VIES screenshot.

tax_review: Note added to account: alternate_legal_names = ["Acme Payments Ltd"]. Ticket #TAX-2026-118 closed after override.

acme_payments: Appreciated, really helped.

maria_support: Thanks, closing thread. :slightly_smiling_face:
